run_training_loop: run an agent on an environment for a specified number of episodes with training and evaluation
run_single_episode: run a single training or evaluation episode with an agent in an environment
write_returns_to_csv: write episode returns data to a CSV file with episode, train, and eval columns
compute_ema: compute an exponential moving average of a value with a configurable decay rate
review_run_function: review the run function that orchestrates training and evaluation episodes with EMA smoothing
